reason: A calm indoor place where both my 4-year-old and my 10-month-old fit, with me sitting right there with coffee, is what I'm short of on rainy days. Baby is free as a drop-in, so I'd try it twice at $12 before I think about a membership.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Ages go up to 5 and I can't tell if there's a separate baby area or any limit on how many kids are in at once.
would_change_my_mind: A visibly separate, gated baby zone and a stated cap on how many kids are in at once.
